-- 0001_schema.sql — enums, core tables, indexes, triggers, audit log, public views (Supabase / PostgreSQL 17)
create type public.complaint_status as enum (
  'submitted',
  'received',
  'assigned',
  'in_progress',
  'waiting_info',
  'forwarded',
  'citizen_confirmation',
  'resolved',
  'closed',
  'rejected',
  'escalated',              -- deadline passed
  'reopened'
);

create type public.urgency_level as enum ('low', 'normal', 'high', 'critical');
create type public.report_channel as enum ('web', 'whatsapp', 'sms');
create type public.user_role as enum ('citizen', 'officer', 'admin');

create type public.update_type as enum (
  'system', 'status', 'note', 'assignment', 'forward', 'escalation',
  'resolution', 'attachment', 'reopened', 'route', 'confirmation', 'urgency'
);

create type public.notif_channel as enum ('whatsapp', 'sms', 'email');
create type public.notif_status  as enum ('pending', 'sent', 'failed');

-- table order matters (FK dependencies)
create table public.institutions (
  id             uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name           text not null,
  code           text not null unique,
  type           text not null default 'agency',
  is_dashboard   boolean not null default false,
  public_visible boolean not null default true,
  contact        jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at     timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.departments (
  id             uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  name           text not null,
  created_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (institution_id, name)
);

create table public.profiles (
  user_id    uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  email      text unique,
  role       public.user_role not null default 'citizen',
  full_name  text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.officers (
  id             uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  department_id  uuid references public.departments(id) on delete set null,
  name           text not null,
  phone          text,
  email          text unique,
  user_id        uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  created_at     timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.categories (
  id                    uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name                  text not null,
  slug                  text not null unique,
  keywords              text[] not null default '{}',
  default_institution_id uuid references public.institutions(id) on delete set null,
  default_department_id  uuid references public.departments(id) on delete set null,
  is_sensitive          boolean not null default false,
  is_emergency          boolean not null default false,
  deadline_hours        int not null default 72,
  created_at            timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.complaint_groups (
  id          uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  category_id uuid references public.categories(id) on delete set null,
  area        text not null default 'unknown',
  opened_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
  closed_at   timestamptz
);

create table public.complaints (
  id                   uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tracking_no          text not null unique,
  title                text not null,
  description          text not null,
  category_id          uuid references public.categories(id) on delete set null,
  urgency              public.urgency_level not null default 'normal',
  status               public.complaint_status not null default 'submitted',
  ai_confidence        numeric(3,2),
  lat                  numeric(9,6),
  lng                  numeric(9,6),
  region               text,
  council_area         text,
  ward                 text,
  photo_url            text,
  channel              public.report_channel not null default 'web',
  citizen_name         text,
  citizen_phone        text,
  is_anonymous         boolean not null default false,
  citizen_id           uuid references public.profiles(user_id) on delete set null,
  institution_id       uuid references public.institutions(id) on delete set null,
  department_id        uuid references public.departments(id) on delete set null,
  officer_id           uuid references public.officers(id) on delete set null,
  group_id             uuid references public.complaint_groups(id) on delete set null,
  expected_response_at timestamptz,
  resolved_at          timestamptz,
  closed_at            timestamptz,
  resolution_note      text,
  resolution_photo_url text,
  reopened_count       int not null default 0,
  created_at           timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at           timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint chk_anonymous_no_identity check (
    not is_anonymous or (citizen_name is null and citizen_phone is null and citizen_id is null)
  ),
  constraint chk_sensitive_routed check (not is_sensitive or institution_id is not null),
  constraint chk_lat_range check (lat is null or (lat >= -90 and lat <= 90)),
  constraint chk_lng_range check (lng is null or (lng >= -180 and lng <= 180)),
  constraint chk_coords_pair check (
    (lat is null and lng is null) or (lat is not null and lng is not null)
  )
);

create table public.complaint_updates (
  id                 uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  complaint_id       uuid not null references public.complaints(id) on delete cascade,
  actor_id           uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  actor_label        text not null default 'system',
  update_type        public.update_type not null default 'status',
  status_from        public.complaint_status,
  status_to          public.complaint_status,
  explanation        text,           -- internal (officer/admin/audit)
  citizen_message    text,           -- citizen-visible timeline entry
  is_citizen_visible boolean not null default false,
  created_at         timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.notifications (
  id           uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  complaint_id uuid not null references public.complaints(id) on delete cascade,
  channel      public.notif_channel not null default 'whatsapp',
  recipient    text not null,
  message      text not null,
  status       public.notif_status not null default 'pending',
  sent_at      timestamptz,
  created_at   timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.audit_log (
  id          uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  actor       text not null default 'system',
  action      text not null,
  table_name  text not null,
  record_id   uuid,
  details     jsonb,
  created_at  timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index idx_complaints_status            on public.complaints (status);
create index idx_complaints_inst_status       on public.complaints (institution_id, status);
create index idx_complaints_due               on public.complaints (expected_response_at);
create index idx_complaints_created           on public.complaints (created_at desc);
create index idx_complaints_group             on public.complaints (group_id) where group_id is not null;
create index idx_complaints_geo               on public.complaints (lat, lng);
create index idx_complaints_phone             on public.complaints (citizen_phone) where citizen_phone is not null;
create index idx_updates_complaint            on public.complaint_updates (complaint_id, created_at);
create index idx_notifications_pending        on public.notifications (status) where status = 'pending';
create index idx_groups_open                  on public.complaint_groups (closed_at) where closed_at is null;

create sequence public.seq_tracking_no start 1;

create or replace function public.fn_set_tracking_no()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if new.tracking_no is null or new.tracking_no = '' then
    new.tracking_no := 'GMC-' || to_char(now(), 'YYYY') || '-' ||
                       lpad(nextval('public.seq_tracking_no'::regclass)::text, 5, '0');
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

create trigger trg_set_tracking_no
  before insert on public.complaints
  for each row execute function public.fn_set_tracking_no();

create or replace function public.fn_touch_updated_at()
returns trigger language plpgsql as $$
begin
  new.updated_at := now();
  return new;
end $$;

create trigger trg_touch_updated_at
  before update on public.complaints
  for each row execute function public.fn_touch_updated_at();

create or replace function public.fn_audit_config()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_record uuid;
begin
  if TG_OP = 'DELETE' then
    v_record := old.id;
  else
    v_record := new.id;
  end if;

  insert into public.audit_log (actor, action, table_name, record_id, details)
  values (
    coalesce(auth.email()::text, auth.uid()::text, 'system'),
    TG_OP,
    TG_TABLE_NAME,
    v_record,
    case when TG_OP = 'DELETE' then to_jsonb(old) else to_jsonb(new) end
  );
  return coalesce(new, old);
end $$;

create trigger trg_audit_institutions
  after insert or update or delete on public.institutions
  for each row execute function public.fn_audit_config();
create trigger trg_audit_departments
  after insert or update or delete on public.departments
  for each row execute function public.fn_audit_config();
create trigger trg_audit_categories
  after insert or update or delete on public.categories
  for each row execute function public.fn_audit_config();
create trigger trg_audit_officers
  after insert or update or delete on public.officers
  for each row execute function public.fn_audit_config();

-- public views bypass RLS (owner-rights); hard-filtered here
create view public.v_public_map as
  select
    c.id, c.tracking_no, c.title, c.urgency, c.status,
    cat.slug  as category_slug,
    cat.name  as category_name,
    c.lat, c.lng, c.ward, c.council_area, c.region,
    c.photo_url, c.created_at, c.resolved_at is not null as has_resolution
  from public.complaints c
  left join public.categories cat on cat.id = c.category_id
  where not c.is_sensitive;

create view public.v_institution_stats as
  select
    i.id as institution_id,
    i.code,
    i.name,
    count(c.id)                                              as total,
    count(c.id) filter (where c.status not in ('closed','rejected')) as open_cases,
    count(c.id) filter (where c.resolved_at is not null)     as resolved_cases,
    round(
      avg(extract(epoch from (c.resolved_at - c.created_at)) / 3600.0)
      filter (where c.resolved_at is not null)::numeric
    , 1)                                                     as avg_resolution_hours
  from public.institutions i
  left join public.complaints c on c.institution_id = i.id
  where i.public_visible
  group by i.id, i.code, i.name;
0006_admin.sql:
-- 0006_admin.sql — admin route override + Central Desk queue
create or replace function public.fn_admin_route(
  p_complaint_id uuid,
  p_institution_id uuid,
  p_department_id uuid default null,
  p_note text default null
) returns boolean
language plpgsql volatile security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  c public.complaints%rowtype;
begin
  if not public.fn_is_admin() then
    return false;
  end if;

  select * into c from public.complaints where id = p_complaint_id;
  if not found then
    return false;
  end if;

  if p_department_id is not null and not exists (
    select 1 from public.departments d
    where d.id = p_department_id and d.institution_id = p_institution_id
  ) then
    return false;
  end if;

  update public.complaints
     set institution_id = p_institution_id,
         department_id  = p_department_id,
         status         = case when c.status in ('submitted') then 'received' else c.status end,
         expected_response_at = public.fn_calculate_deadline(c.category_id, c.urgency)
   where id = c.id;

  insert into public.complaint_updates (
    complaint_id, actor_id, actor_label, update_type,
    status_from, status_to, explanation, is_citizen_visible
  )
  select c.id, auth.uid(), 'admin', 'route',
         c.status,
         case when c.status = 'submitted' then 'received' else c.status end,
         coalesce(p_note, 'Manual route override by admin'), false;

  return true;
end $$;

create or replace function public.fn_central_desk_queue()
returns table (
  id uuid,
  tracking_no text,
  title text,
  description text,
  status public.complaint_status,
  urgency public.urgency_level,
  ai_confidence numeric,
  institution text,
  created_at timestamptz
)
language sql stable security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select c.id, c.tracking_no, c.title, c.description, c.status, c.urgency,
         c.ai_confidence, i.name, c.created_at
  from public.complaints c
  left join public.institutions i on i.id = c.institution_id
  where c.status = 'submitted'
  order by c.urgency = 'critical' desc, c.created_at asc;
$$;

-- pushes demo cases through the real officer RPCs (via _demo_as_officer impersonation) so every state exists
create or replace function public._demo_as_officer(
  p_email text,
  p_action text,
  p_complaint uuid,
  p_arg1 text default null,
  p_arg2 uuid default null,
  p_arg3 text default null
) returns text
language plpgsql volatile security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_user uuid;
  v_ok boolean;
begin
  select id into v_user from auth.users where email = p_email;
  if v_user is null then
    return 'no user';
  end if;
  -- set request.jwt.claims so auth.uid() works inside the RPC
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claims',
    json_build_object('sub', v_user::text, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);

  if p_action = 'accept' then
    v_ok := public.fn_officer_accept(p_complaint);
  elsif p_action = 'status' then
    v_ok := public.fn_officer_set_status(p_complaint, p_arg1, p_arg3);
  elsif p_action = 'note' then
    v_ok := public.fn_officer_note(p_complaint, p_arg3);
  elsif p_action = 'urgency' then
    v_ok := public.fn_officer_set_urgency(p_complaint, p_arg1);
  elsif p_action = 'reject' then
    v_ok := public.fn_officer_reject(p_complaint, p_arg3);
  else
    v_ok := false;
  end if;

  perform set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
  if v_ok then return 'ok'; else return 'rejected'; end if;
end $$;

do $life$
declare
  r record;
  v_id uuid;
begin
  select c.id into v_id from public.complaints c
  join public.categories cat on cat.id = c.category_id
  where cat.slug = 'waste_collection' and c.title like 'Overflowing dumpster%'
  order by c.created_at limit 1;
  perform public._demo_as_officer('fatou.ceesay@kmc.gm', 'accept', v_id);
  perform public._demo_as_officer('fatou.ceesay@kmc.gm', 'status', v_id, 'in_progress');
  perform public._demo_as_officer('fatou.ceesay@kmc.gm', 'note', v_id, null, null, 'Sanitation crew dispatched for tomorrow 7am pickup.');
  perform public._demo_as_officer('fatou.ceesay@kmc.gm', 'status', v_id, 'citizen_confirmation', null, 'Dumpster emptied and area washed. Photo attached by crew.');

  for r in
    select c.id from public.complaints c
    join public.categories cat on cat.id = c.category_id
    join public.institutions i on i.id = c.institution_id
    where cat.slug = 'water_supply' and i.code = 'NAWEC'
      and c.title like 'Water outage in Brikama%'
  loop
    perform public._demo_as_officer('musa.darboe@nawec.gm', 'accept', r.id);
    perform public._demo_as_officer('musa.darboe@nawec.gm', 'status', r.id, 'in_progress');
  end loop;

  select c.id into v_id from public.complaints c
  join public.categories cat on cat.id = c.category_id
  where cat.slug = 'pollution' and c.title like 'Factory smoke%'
  order by c.created_at limit 1;
  perform public._demo_as_officer('isatou.njie@nea.gm', 'accept', v_id);
  update public.complaints
     set expected_response_at = now() - interval '2 hours'
   where id = v_id;

  select c.id into v_id from public.complaints c
  join public.categories cat on cat.id = c.category_id
  where cat.slug = 'local_roads' and c.title like 'Pothole on Kairaba%'
  order by c.created_at limit 1;
  perform public._demo_as_officer('lamin.jobe@kmc.gm', 'accept', v_id);
  perform public._demo_as_officer('lamin.jobe@kmc.gm', 'status', v_id, 'in_progress');
  perform public._demo_as_officer('lamin.jobe@kmc.gm', 'status', v_id, 'citizen_confirmation', null, 'Pothole filled with asphalt this morning.');
  update public.complaints
     set status = 'closed', closed_at = now()
   where id = v_id;
  update public.complaint_updates
     set citizen_message = 'Resolution confirmed by citizen. Thank you.'
   where complaint_id = v_id and citizen_message like 'Crew reports fixed%';

  select c.id into v_id from public.complaints c
  join public.categories cat on cat.id = c.category_id
  where cat.slug = 'water_supply' and c.title like 'Water leak at Westfield%'
  order by c.created_at limit 1;
  perform public._demo_as_officer('musa.darboe@nawec.gm', 'accept', v_id);
  perform public._demo_as_officer('musa.darboe@nawec.gm', 'status', v_id, 'citizen_confirmation', null, 'Pipe clamp replaced, leak stopped.');
  update public.complaints
     set resolved_at = now() - interval '80 hours'
   where id = v_id;

  select c.id into v_id from public.complaints c
  join public.categories cat on cat.id = c.category_id
  where cat.slug = 'markets' and c.title like 'Market stall dispute%'
  order by c.created_at limit 1;
  perform public._demo_as_officer('fatou.ceesay@kmc.gm', 'reject', v_id, null, null, 'This is a private dispute between vendors; please seek mediation at the bantaba.');

end $life$;
